pattern: group by entity, conditional sum and count, single-row share calculation
question: share of money raised from repeat givers versus one-time givers, in percent, plus a count of repeat givers
gold_sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS gifts, SUM("Amount") AS donor_total FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor") SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN donor_total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(donor_total) AS repeat_share_percent, SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_donor_count FROM counts
sql_duckdb: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN repeat_flag = 1 THEN Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(Amount), 0), 0), 2) AS repeat_givers_percent, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN repeat_flag = 1 THEN Donor END) AS repeat_givers_count FROM (SELECT Donor, Amount, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY Donor) > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repeat_flag FROM donations) AS sub

CURRENT QUESTION:
share of money raised from repeat givers versus one-time givers, in percent, plus a count of repeat givers
attempts.response:
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN repeat_flag = 1 THEN Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) /
    NULLIF(SUM(Amount), 0),
    2
  ) AS repeat_givers_percent,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN repeat_flag = 1 THEN Donor END) AS repeat_givers_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    Donor,
    Amount,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY Donor) > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repeat_flag
  FROM donations
) sub;
